content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation on § 14.2 (with conforming edits to §§ 14.1 and 15.1).**

- **Problem:** § 14.2 vests exclusive ownership of every Deliverable created for us in Vendor, leaving us a *revocable, non-transferable* licence expiring with the Order Form term. That fails even the fallback (no perpetual/irrevocable/worldwide/royalty-free, modifiable, sublicensable licence) for work we fund.
- **Target:** preferred, because most preferred elements are already in the document — § 14.3 (Vendor retains Vendor Technology), § 13.2 (perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to embedded Vendor Technology), § 14.1 (Customer owns Customer Data), § 14.4 (no joint IP) — so only two gaps remained.
- **Operative changes (3 surgical edits):**
  1. § 14.2 flipped to Customer exclusive ownership plus an express Vendor assignment; the contradictory revocable term-limited licence sentence is removed.
  2. § 14.1 Vendor's data right narrowed from "provide, secure, support, and improve" to processing **solely to provide the Services**.
  3. § 15.1 narrowed to processing solely to provide the Services on our documented instructions, deleting the "as permitted by this Agreement" hook and the consent-based sale/advertising/model-training carve-out (a consent exception is not an element-complete data-use limitation).

Unrelated text (acceptance, warranty, transition, Vendor Technology retention) is untouched.
